note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped DSperate binary. A fresh clone of this repository plus Docker is the whole toolchain: no sibling checkout, no locally built image, no opaque downloaded binary. DSperate is built from the pinned commit with the pak's patches in `patches/`, applied in order; each is locked by sha256 and the build refuses a mismatch. `make standalone` refuses a source archive or artifact whose sha256 does not match this file.

vulkan_headers.note: Build-time headers only, fetched by commit like the DSperate source and mounted read-only at /vulkan-include. The same release PPSSPP 1.20.4 vendors. The corresponding-source archive carries include/ and the licence.

build.sdl2: device-provided libSDL2-2.0.so.0, linked dynamically; the MLP1 ships 2.28.5 built with its Wayland video driver
build.wayland_note: The toolchain sysroot's SDL2 2.28.5 is built without its Wayland driver, so its SDL_config.h leaves SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER_WAYLAND undefined and SDL_syswm.h hides SDL_SysWMinfo's Wayland fields. Defining the macro for this build exposes those fields without changing the toolchain, and is what lets the intended dmabuf tier compile. The public union reserves the fields' space regardless, and the binary links the device's Wayland-capable SDL at runtime. The build fails if the probe or display_wl.cpp does not confirm the real tier.
build.source_date_note: The pinned v3.0.5 commit's committer timestamp.
build.cheevos_version_note: Passed explicitly because a shallow checkout has no tags for upstream's `git describe` fallback.
build.pgo_note: A fresh aarch64 profile is trained with this pak's own toolchain (Buildroot GCC 12.3.0) and these flags against the patched v3.0.5 source by standalone/pgo-train.sh, so its fingerprint matches the release build. Upstream v3.0.5 ships profiles for other GCC versions only, which this toolchain refuses.
build.vulkan_note: On. DSperate 3 builds its Vulkan dma-buf presenter and the optional GPU 3D raster against the Khronos headers pinned under vulkan_headers, mounted at /vulkan-include; nothing links libvulkan, which the binary dlopens on the device. On the MLP1 the presenter runs on the stock Mali driver and is what holds Golden Sun: Dark Dawn at full speed. Since v3.0.5 it is tried first and draws with a render pass on the scanout buffer instead of a compute pass. GPU 3D stays off by default (upstream's default). v3's other presenter, the RGA through V4L2 mem2mem, declines on the MLP1, whose stock kernel exposes the RGA only as /dev/rga.

pgo.scenes: mlbis sm64 etody dbori meteos gsdd st nsmb
pgo.note: Trained by standalone/pgo-train.sh with this pak's toolchain and the lock's own flags against the patched v3.0.5 tree with the Vulkan presenter built, so the fingerprint matches the release build. The scenes are upstream v3.0.5's list, unchanged from v3.0.3: five recorded replays and three boots from frame 0, all eight of which ran. Upstream's two DSi scenes need DSi dumps and are not trained, as for 3.0.3. The headless frontend is the training build; the SDL frontend and the windowless video library only it links, rcheevos and the reference kernels are never trained. Verify with -DDSPERATE_PGO_STRICT=ON: 0 unexpected objects without a profile and 0 coverage mismatches.

version.note: Locked --version identity. The build exports DSPERATE_LOCK_VERSION and DSPERATE_LOCK_COMMIT, and cmake/version.cmake prefers them over git, so a source archive without git and a patched checkout git would call dirty both report v3.0.5 (ddf2910).

patches.note: Adds --cache-root-only, --single-rom and --inspect-cart, backed by cart.cache_root_only and cart.single_nds, plus unsafe entry-path rejection. Rebased onto v3.0.5, where only an include line conflicted (upstream added <optional>); the policy features are still absent upstream, so they are carried. A refused archive sets the loader's error like any other, so v3.0.5's start-failure screen reports it. The pak's wrapper pins the extraction cache to its own root, requires exactly one image entry, and sizes the cache before launch. See PROVENANCE.md.

Keeps checked flush, fsync, close and rename for battery-save and save-state writes, plus checked firmware-override flush and close. Upstream v3.0.5 still writes these unchecked. Retains upstream save loading, chip detection and mismatch backups. See PROVENANCE.md.

Stops the host-resume lid pulse on a device with no lid switch. Upstream fabricates a lid close/open cycle on every resume, and since v3.0.4 holds that close for at least 60 frames; games that blank their screens on lid-close and restore them only on an open they saw coming (Contra 4) stay black. The pulse now only fires for a lid already believed closed. Rebased onto v3.0.4's held-close logic, keeping upstream's one-frame pulse. See PROVENANCE.md.

Makes --version report the lock's tag and commit deterministically. Upstream's generator derives the tag from git describe and the commit from git rev-parse, so a source archive without git says unknown and a patched checkout says <hash>-dirty. This patch prefers DSPERATE_LOCK_VERSION and DSPERATE_LOCK_COMMIT when the packager sets them, and leaves ordinary git development unchanged.

The standalone-ra-account-v1 consumer. Adds the shared contract classifier and marker (verbatim with the Flycast consumer and the leaf-contracts reference), the managed-account bridge with its own checked token writer (same-directory temporary, write, fsync, close, rename, each checked; the revision is accepted only after it), and the native login wiring (import, one password retry, sign-out). Captures and scrubs UMRK_RA_ACCOUNT_* at startup; an explicit cheevos.enabled = false or --no-cheevos wins over a managed account; bridge failures reach the native pop-up path even with toasts off; an unmanaged sign-in stays session-only as upstream. Never writes a password or token to a log or argv.
